- Added helper properties (is_standard_compiler, is_osx_compiler, is_windows_compiler)
- Updated all compiler classes to use the new enum
- Modified compiler detection logic to return enum values
- Updated tests to check against enum values instead of constants

Refactor command-line argument handling into CommandLineParser

Move argument parsing logic from individual command modules to a centralized CommandLineParser class. Each command now provides add_arguments() and run() functions instead of handling parsing internally. This standardizes the command interface and reduces code duplication.

Add VC environment setup for VS2010 backend

Implement proper VC environment detection and setup for Visual Studio builds. The change:
- Adds a new method to detect and construct vcvars command
- Uses the detected command in the build process
- Fixes architecture detection for MSVC 2017
- Corrects error message for unsupported target platform

Extract LLVM tool name generation into shared function

The list of possible LLVM tool name variants (like 'llvm-config-8', 'llvm-config80') was duplicated for both llvm-config and scan-build detection. This change moves the common logic to a new `get_llvm_tool_names()` function in environment.py.

Add centralized git command helper

The change introduces a shared `git()` function in mesonlib.py to handle git operations consistently across the codebase. It replaces direct subprocess calls with git commands, particularly fixing ANSI color issues on Windows by properly handling console modes. The helper is then used in msubprojects.py and wrap.py, removing duplicate git command implementations.

Restructure TestResult to track steps incrementally

Simplify TestResult class by initializing with empty defaults and adding data incrementally through methods. This makes the test execution flow clearer and reduces redundant parameter passing. The change also improves error handling by centralizing failure reporting.

```
Add TestProtocol enum for test execution

Replace string-based test protocol handling with a proper enum. This improves type safety and makes the code more maintainable by centralizing protocol validation and string conversions.

The enum is used in TestSerialization, test execution logic, and introspection output. String protocol values are now validated when creating Test objects.
```

```
Handle wrap-redirect files in subproject purge

Add support for deleting wrap-redirect files during subproject purge operations.
Track original filenames and redirection status in PackageDefinition.
Use windows_proof_rmtree for more reliable directory removal.
```

Add support for saving intermediate UMAP embeddings

Allow n_epochs to be a list of epoch numbers at which to save intermediate embeddings. The optimization will run for the maximum number of epochs specified, and return all requested embeddings in order of increasing epoch. This enables tracking the evolution of the embedding during optimization.

Update civilization victory requirements

Added Louvre and Metropolitain to French goals, Shalimar Gardens to Mughals goals, and Brooklyn/Golden Gate Bridges to American goals. Removed Harmandir Sahib and Statue of Liberty from respective civilizations' requirements. Updated all related text descriptions.

Add region support to S3 storage driver

The change introduces a region-aware S3 driver implementation. It replaces the old per-region driver classes with a single driver that can be configured for any AWS region. The driver now validates regions against a predefined map and provides better error messages when accessing buckets in wrong regions. Also adds a method to list all supported regions.

Move package utilities into setup.py to avoid dependencies

The change moves package discovery and data file collection utilities from libcloud.utils.dist into setup.py. This prevents setup.py from depending on Libcloud code which may require additional dependencies. Also updates tox configuration to test installation in a clean environment.

Add support for range downloads in storage drivers

Implement `download_object_range` and `download_object_range_as_stream` methods in base storage driver and local/S3 implementations. These methods allow downloading partial object content by specifying byte ranges. The changes include modifications to `_save_object` to handle partial downloads correctly.

Add support for partial content downloads in Azure Blobs

Implement range download functionality for Azure Blobs storage driver, similar to existing S3 implementation. Move common range string generation to a shared method in StorageDriver base class. Handle PARTIAL_CONTENT response status code in Azure response handler.

Add timeout parameter to deployment scripts

The change introduces an optional timeout parameter for script deployments, allowing users to specify a maximum execution time for remote commands. This affects both ScriptDeployment and ScriptFileDeployment classes, with corresponding updates to the SSH client interface and test cases. The timeout is passed through to the underlying SSH client's run method.

Handle XML responses with or without namespaces

Add utility functions to parse XML responses that may or may not include namespaces. The new functions first attempt to find elements using the specified namespace, then fall back to a namespace-less search if nothing is found. This improves compatibility with AWS responses that inconsistently include namespaces.

Add mock HTTP class for all OpenStack auth versions

The change introduces a new mock HTTP class `OpenStack_AllAuthVersions_MockHttp` that handles all supported OpenStack authentication versions. It also adds a test case to verify driver instantiation with all possible auth versions, including proper handling of version-specific parameters.

Improve file handling and alias support in SqliteStore

- Add file path normalization and standard input detection
- Extend file info handling to support aliases and exact path matching
- Implement set_file_alias to rename file references
- Modify has_graph and add_graph to work with aliases
- Handle standard input properly in import operations
- Remove redundant realpath conversions in file operations

Add support for CONCAT function and refactor function calls

Extract function call translation into a separate method `function_call_to_sql` and implement special handling for CONCAT (using SQLite's || operator), CAST, and LIKELIHOOD functions. This improves code organization and adds missing CONCAT support.

Handle virtual graphs in Kypher query translation

Add special-case translation for virtual graph pattern clauses and skip index creation on virtual tables. Track virtual tables in TranslationState to avoid unnecessary indexing.

Add `dont_optimize` flag to control SQL join ordering

The change introduces a new `dont_optimize` parameter to preserve the original graph table order in SQL joins, which helps maintain consistent query optimization behavior. This includes modifications to join clause generation and pattern clause handling to support the new flag.

Rename `ref_geom` parameter to `geom` in various functions

The parameter name was changed for consistency across the codebase. This affects JFactory, background, counts, exposure, PSF map, and map maker classes and functions. The functionality remains unchanged.

Make dataset and model names unique by default

Add automatic name generation for datasets and models when no name is provided. Ensure unique names in collections by replacing duplicates. This prevents naming conflicts in analysis workflows.

Add model processing flags for PSF and EDISP

Introduce a `processing` attribute in `SkyModelBase` to control PSF and EDISP application. The flags are now checked in `MapEvaluator` and `SpectrumEvaluator` before applying these corrections. Default values are set to enabled (1), but can be customized during model initialization or updated later.

Make model tags support multiple values

Update model tag system to allow multiple tag values per model. This enables more flexible model identification while maintaining backward compatibility. Tests and related code are updated to check for tag membership rather than exact equality.

Add `full_output` option to model serialization

Allow simplified YAML output by omitting default parameter values when `full_output=False`. This reduces file size for cases where only non-default parameter values need to be stored.

```
Add PiecewiseBrokenPowerLawSpectralModel

Implement a new spectral model with piecewise power-law segments at fixed energy nodes. The model supports serialization and includes validation for input parameters.
```

Fix comment handling parameter name inconsistency

The parameter `ignore_comments` was renamed to `ignore_data_comments` in data section functions to match the naming convention and avoid confusion with header section comment handling. Documentation was updated to clarify comment line handling behavior.

Add graceful shutdown and config reload to speech recognition

- Implement stop() methods for AudioProducer and ResponsiveRecognizer
- Add proper thread cleanup in RecognizerLoop.stop()
- Support config reloading by checking config hash periodically
- Skip audio processing when audio is None in AudioConsumer
- Add stop signal handling in wake word detection loop

Add once parameter to add_event for single-run handlers

The change introduces a new 'once' parameter to add_event that allows event handlers to be automatically removed after their first execution. This simplifies scheduling one-time events and ensures proper cleanup.

The implementation also includes:
- Fix for variable shadowing in error handling
- More robust event removal with error handling
- Updated unit tests to verify the new behavior

Simplify intent handler registration

Remove global intent lists and store intent data directly on decorated functions. The registration now scans class methods for intent metadata instead of using module-level lists. This makes the intent registration more self-contained and removes the need for global state.

Change skill ID handling from numeric to alphanumeric

Replace numeric skill IDs with string-based alphanumeric IDs. The `to_letters()` function is renamed to `to_alnum()` and now converts any non-alphanumeric characters to underscores. This affects skill registration, intent handling, and vocabulary loading across the codebase. Tests are updated to use string IDs instead of numeric ones.

Add seek forward/backward functionality to audio service

Implement seek controls in the audio service, allowing tracks to be skipped forward or rewound by specified seconds. Includes message bus handlers, abstract methods in AudioBackend, and VLC implementation.

Simplify skill settings synchronization logic

Remove complex hash-based synchronization and multi-device settings merging. Now only syncs with the current device's settings using skill_gid as identifier. Clean up related unused methods and simplify the settings update flow.

Update metaclass syntax to Python 3 style

Replace old `__metaclass__` attribute with Python 3's metaclass parameter in class definitions. This change affects base classes across audio, STT, and TTS services, making the code more modern and consistent with current Python practices.

Extend register_intent to handle intent files directly

Move Adapt intent registration logic to helper method and allow
register_intent to accept both intent parsers and intent files.
Mark intent_file_handler decorator as deprecated since register_intent
can now handle both cases. Update tests to verify new functionality.

Add test case handling methods to SkillTest class

Extract test case execution logic into separate methods for better organization and readability. New methods handle loading test cases, sending different types of test inputs, managing contexts, and processing results. The main execute_test method now delegates to these focused methods while maintaining the same functionality.

Fix listen flag handling in TTS playback

The listen flag was being handled inconsistently between speech chunks. Now it's properly applied only to the last chunk of an utterance. This ensures the microphone only activates after the final speech segment when expect_response is requested.

Improve cache curation with helper functions

Extract cache cleanup logic into separate helper functions for better readability and maintainability. Added mb_to_bytes() for size conversion and split file deletion logic into _get_cache_entries() and _delete_oldest(). The core functionality remains unchanged but is now more modular.

Add fallback handler wrapper tracking

Introduce a wrapper_map to track original handlers and their wrappers. This enables proper cleanup when removing fallbacks and ensures handlers can be correctly identified for removal. The remove_fallback method now returns a boolean indicating success and handles cases where the same handler is removed multiple times.

Add MessageWaiter class for waiting on bus messages

Encapsulate message waiting logic into a reusable MessageWaiter class. The class provides a cleaner way to wait for specific message types, separating setup from waiting. Also adds a convenience wait_for_message method to MessageBusClient and refactors wait_for_response to use the new class. Includes unit tests for the new functionality.

Implement process status tracking for skills service

Add ProcessStatus class to track and report skill service state changes. Move status callbacks and message handling from SkillManager to the new centralized process tracking system. This provides consistent state management and reporting across services.

Add configurable FFmpeg library names for Windows

The change introduces a new option `ffmpeg_libs_win` to specify FFmpeg DLL filenames on Windows, where versioned filenames are common. The FFmpeg library loading logic now uses these configured names with fallback to default names. This makes it easier to support different FFmpeg versions on Windows.

Implement packet queue management for FFmpegSource

Add AudioPacket class and refactor video/audio packet handling to use queues with size limits. Introduce methods to manage queue filling and consumption, improving seek operations and packet processing. Remove old buffering system in favor of more robust queue-based approach.

Replace threading with pyglet.clock for audio buffer management

The change removes thread-based synchronization and replaces it with pyglet.clock scheduling for audio buffer refills. The RLock and worker thread management are no longer needed as buffer updates are now handled through scheduled callbacks. This simplifies the synchronization model while maintaining audio playback functionality.

Fix silent audio playback and improve test coverage

- Dispatch EOS event for silent audio sources when no driver is available
- Clean up test formatting and add test for silent audio driver case
- Remove redundant source format clearing when audio driver fails
- Improve code style consistency (whitespace, line breaks)

Change stattype syntax from 'MODEL ... AS' to 'SET STATTYPE OF ... TO'

The diff updates the syntax for specifying column stattypes in population creation from 'MODEL column AS stattype' to either 'SET STATTYPE OF column TO stattype' or simply 'column stattype'. This affects grammar rules, parsing, and all test cases. The change makes the syntax more explicit and consistent with SQL conventions.

Add support for conditional mutual information in Loom backend

Implement proper handling of constraints in column_mutual_information by:
- Adding constraint marginalization when values are unspecified
- Converting constraints to Loom's required format
- Averaging MI estimates across multiple constraint samples

The change ensures mutual information calculations respect provided constraints while maintaining compatibility with Loom's interface.

Fix model loading and SBOL import warnings

- Replace deprecated string comparison operator with '==' in distributed sensitivity analysis
- Use loadSBMLModel instead of sbmlToAntimony conversion for direct SBML loading
- Clear Antimony previous loads before conversions to prevent state issues
- Log SBOL import errors at warning level
- Remove unused 'sys' import
- Fix archive entry handling in extractFileFromCombineArchive

Remove sbml2matlab import and make phrasedml imports optional

The change removes the sbml2matlab import from Spyder's startup lines and makes all phrasedml-related imports and functionality optional in the teconverters module. This improves error handling when phrasedml is not available.

Add descriptor wallet support to wallet_send.py test

Modified the wallet_send.py functional test to properly handle descriptor wallets. The test now:
- Creates wallets with explicit descriptor imports when --descriptors is used
- Uses different setup paths for legacy vs descriptor wallets
- Skips legacy-specific test cases when testing descriptor wallets
- Adds a new test run with --descriptors flag in test_runner.py

Add profiling context manager and use it in scheduler

The change introduces a new `profiling_context` class to handle profiling enable/disable logic in a context manager pattern. This replaces direct `_profile.enable()`/`_profile.disable()` calls in the scheduler with context manager usage, making the profiling state handling more robust and cleaner.

Also adds a `nullcontext` backport from Python 3.7 for cases when profiling is disabled.

```
Move test discovery logic to factory method

Separate test and hook discovery from RegressionManager initialization by introducing a from_discovery() factory method. This makes the class more flexible for custom test loading while maintaining the existing discovery behavior.
```

Add task IDs and improved coroutine stack traces

- Assign unique IDs to tasks for better debugging
- Implement coroutine stack trace extraction for more detailed error reporting
- Improve task string representation with ID and status information
- Fix test logging to use original function names instead of task names

Optimize binary string resolution with translation table

Replace character-by-character string manipulation with a Unicode translation table for resolving binary values. The new approach is more efficient and maintains the same behavior for handling special characters (x, z, etc.) based on the COCOTB_RESOLVE_X environment variable.

Replace TxnActions with Operations for datastore mutations

The change replaces all instances of TxnActions.PUT/DELETE with Operations.PUT/DELETE in mutation operations. This provides clearer semantics for datastore operations by separating transaction actions from entity operations. The new Operations class better represents the actual operations being performed on entities.

Move Celery utility functions to utils module

Extracted Celery-related helper methods from TaskQueueConfig class into the utils module for better code organization and reusability. This includes functions for generating queue names, function names, and annotation names used in Celery configuration.

Add Monit status tracking and async operations

Introduce MonitStates constants class and MonitOperator for async interactions with Monit's API. The operator provides methods to check process status, send commands, and wait for desired states. Includes helper functions for parsing Monit's XML responses and handling retries.

Initialize ZooKeeper client before creating DeploymentConfig

The change modifies how DeploymentConfig is initialized by requiring
a pre-configured KazooClient instance instead of creating one internally.
This provides more control over the ZooKeeper connection lifecycle
and ensures the client is properly started before use. The change affects
multiple components that interact with the deployment configuration.

Improve ZooKeeper watch handling and cleanup

Add proper cleanup for ZooKeeper watches when projects or config sections are deleted. Store ZK client references in classes for watch restoration. Add checks to prevent unnecessary watches after deletion. Implement consistent watch restoration pattern across components.

Add ID reservation system to prevent reuse

Introduce a mechanism to reserve entity IDs so they won't be reallocated. This includes:
- Adding a cache for last reserved IDs to reduce Cassandra requests
- Implementing set_min_counter in both allocator types
- Adding sequential allocator tracking in DatastoreDistributed
- Supporting v4 AllocateIds API for ID reservation

Simplify error handling and response construction

The changes streamline error handling across various datastore operations by:
- Removing redundant response object creation before error checks
- Consistently returning empty strings for error responses
- Simplifying error message construction
- Moving response object creation after successful operations
- Removing unnecessary parentheses in return statements

These changes make the code more consistent and easier to maintain while preserving all existing functionality.

Replace custom lock handling with EntityLock class

The diff removes the manual lock acquisition/release logic in DatastoreGroomer and replaces it with the new EntityLock context manager. This simplifies the code by handling ZooKeeper transactions automatically while maintaining the same locking behavior. The change affects both single property index cleanup and kind index deletion operations.

Add support for external API server configuration

The changes introduce a new parameter to configure an external API server for handling specific service calls. This allows routing certain API calls (like app_identity_service) to an external server while keeping others local. The configuration is passed through multiple layers from command line to runtime setup.

Track transaction groups in ZooKeeper

Add transaction group tracking by storing group paths in ZooKeeper when creating transactions. This ensures proper locking and coordination for distributed transactions. The change includes new methods to convert transaction IDs to paths and store group information, while maintaining backward compatibility with existing transaction handling.

Handle entity lock timeouts explicitly

Replace context manager usage with explicit lock acquisition/release to better handle timeout cases. Add new TimeoutError exception class for lock timeouts and propagate it consistently across datastore operations. This makes lock timeout behavior more predictable and easier to debug.

Simplify transaction rollback handling

Remove unused imports and streamline the rollback_transaction method to directly accept a transaction ID instead of encoded request data. The method now raises InternalError on failure rather than returning error codes. Update callers to handle the new interface.

Add datastore index management API endpoint

Implement a new handler for managing datastore indexes, allowing applications to add new indexes via YAML payload. The handler validates and stores indexes in ZooKeeper, merging new indexes with existing ones. Includes IndexProperty and DatastoreIndex classes for index representation and validation.

Replace ring status with gossip-based rebalancing

The rebalance logic now uses gossip information instead of ring status to determine node load and tokens. Added command-line flags to skip token and ownership checks when needed. Simplified the node data collection and improved error handling for cluster state validation.

Add port conflict validation and version cleanup

- Validate HAProxy config to prevent duplicate port usage
- Add proper version cleanup when stopping routing
- Handle null version details gracefully
- Make active flag private and add stop() method for cleanup

Remove distributed transaction commit method

The commit_transaction method was moved from DatastoreDistributed to MainHandler, consolidating transaction handling in one place. The distributed version was redundant as it contained identical logic to the handler's implementation. Corresponding test was also removed.

Add support for custom service accounts in backups

Pass service account credentials through the backup pipeline to enable custom authentication for GCS operations. This includes validation, file writing, and cleanup tasks. The UI now includes a field to specify the service account.

Implement OAuth2 token generation for service accounts

Add support for generating OAuth2 access tokens using JWT assertions. The change includes:
- New service account handling with Zookeeper storage
- JWT assertion generation with proper audience and scopes
- Token exchange with Google's OAuth2 endpoint
- Updated crypto module with PKCS1v15 padding and JWT support

Add service account support for datastore admin operations

Move service account functionality to utils.py and integrate it with backup/restore flows. This allows specifying service accounts when performing datastore operations through the admin interface. The change includes UI updates to select accounts and passes the account ID through all relevant operations.

Add property iterator for datastore metadata

Implement PropertyIterator to fetch indexed property names and their types for a kind. This includes handling property type ranges in SinglePropIndex and proper entity encoding for property metadata queries. The changes enable querying property metadata similar to kind metadata.

Reorganize plot file storage structure

Changed plot file storage to use group-specific subdirectories instead of embedding group names in filenames. Updated storage helper functions to support this new structure while maintaining backward compatibility. Tests were adjusted to reflect these changes.

Extract version details into RepoVersion class

The change encapsulates version-specific parameters (repository URLs, revisions) into a dedicated RepoVersion class. This simplifies the AbiChecker interface by reducing constructor parameters and centralizes version-related data handling. The class also stores ABI dumps and module information, making the code more organized and maintainable.

Improve metadata merging with origin tracking

Enhance the metadata combiner script to better track data origins and handle conflicts. The script now:
- Provides clearer error messages for input validation
- Tracks which strains come from which origin files
- Adds origin markers ("yes"/"no") for all origins to all strains
- Improves help text and documentation
- Maintains backward compatibility with augur filter

Add helper functions for metadata sanitization

Extract column renaming and prefix stripping logic into separate reusable functions. The new `parse_new_column_names` handles column renaming rules while `strip_prefixes` removes specified prefixes from strain names. This improves code organization and maintainability while keeping the same functionality.

Add support for '.' to select current directory in commands

The change allows using '.' as a shorthand for the current working directory
in various tmt commands (test, plan, story). This simplifies working with
tests and plans located in the current directory without needing to specify
the full path. Documentation and examples have been updated accordingly.

Improve Fedora image URL guessing logic

Expand the image name mapping to support more aliases like 'fedora-32', 'f-32' and 'f32'. Add support for detecting the latest released Fedora version. Remove hardcoded rawhide URLs and implement dynamic compose detection.

Move Guest class from base to steps.provision module

The Guest class implementation was relocated from tmt.base to tmt.steps.provision since it's more logically related to the provisioning functionality. This change improves code organization by grouping provisioning-related components together. The import in tmt/__init__.py was updated accordingly, and all references to the Guest class were adjusted to use the new location.

```
Improve debug messages in minute provision plugin

Make debug messages more consistent by using present tense and quotes for paths. Also simplify some messages for better clarity.
```

Improve beakerlib library default branch handling

Simplify the default branch detection logic and remove redundant ref handling. The default branch is now detected directly from the origin after cloning. Also parametrize the test for different default branch names.

Add package requirements for all step plugins  

Implement `requires()` methods across all step plugins to collect package dependencies needed by each step. The prepare step now aggregates requirements from all other steps to ensure necessary packages are installed on the guest. This enables proper functionality of all steps without manual package management.

Add updatable progress messages for Artemis provisioning

Introduce a new `updatable_message` utility class for displaying progress updates in-place. Use it in Artemis provisioning to show guest state changes with color coding. The utility supports indentation and preserves message width during updates.

Make retry_session a context manager

Convert retry_session into a context manager to ensure proper session cleanup. Simplify HTTP retry logic by consolidating it into a single class. Update all callers to use the new context manager interface.

Replace guest data handling with dataclasses

Refactor guest data management to use dataclasses for better type safety and maintainability. This change introduces a hierarchy of dataclasses to represent guest data across different provision methods, replacing the previous dictionary-based approach. The new implementation provides clearer structure, type hints, and reduces boilerplate code for data serialization.

Improve guest reboot detection and add disk size

Replace unreliable connection drop detection with boot time check for reboots. Also add disk size configuration in test plans.

Remove optional `keys` parameter from plugin wake methods

The `keys` parameter was unused in most plugin implementations and its functionality could be handled by the base class. This simplifies the wake method signature across all plugins while maintaining the same behavior.

Store test case identifiers in a structured way

Replace the simple `id` field with a dictionary `ids` that holds multiple identifiers for test cases. This allows better tracking and matching of test cases across different systems like Polarion and Nitrate. The change also simplifies the Polarion reporting logic by separating the ID lookup into a dedicated function.

Add pygrep-hooks and improve type ignore comments

Introduce new static analysis hooks for Python code to enforce specific error codes with `noqa` and `type: ignore`. Also update various `type: ignore` comments to include specific error codes for better type checking precision.

Add import_member helper for dynamic imports

Extract dynamic member import logic into a reusable helper function. The new import_member function handles module and member lookup with proper error handling. Use it in SerializableContainer and _prenormalize_fmf_node to reduce code duplication. Add tests for various import scenarios.

Implement spec-based container for serialization and deserialization

Introduce `SpecBasedContainer` class to handle conversion between objects and their specification forms. Update related classes to use new container methods (`to_spec`/`from_spec`) instead of raw serialization methods. Document the changes in `classes.rst`.

Move guest initialization to base ProvisionPlugin class

The guest initialization during wake() was duplicated across multiple provision plugins. This change centralizes the logic in the base ProvisionPlugin class by adding a _guest attribute and moving the wake() implementation there. Individual plugins no longer need their own wake() methods for guest initialization.

Add logging for trial creation and fix Sobol model resuming

Log trial parameters when creating or resuming trials in AutoSearchJob. Improve Sobol model resuming in AxSearchJob by fixing the seed and properly skipping already generated trials.

Simplify dataset preprocessing script and improve config handling

Remove --folder flag in favor of positional argument. Clean up preprocessing code with better variable names and structure. Add dataset.yaml generation with metadata. Update dataset loading to respect dataset.yaml overrides.

Add support for s*o combine mode in scoring

Implement score_so method to compute scores for triples formed from subject-object pairs and relations. Fall back to parent class for unsupported combine modes instead of raising errors.

Replace asterisk wildcards with underscores in query patterns

The change updates all instances of 'sp*' and '*po' query patterns to use underscores ('sp_' and '_po') instead of asterisks for wildcard matching. This affects scoring methods across multiple models and documentation. The semantic meaning remains unchanged, only the syntax is updated for consistency.

Use SelectionPredicateComposition for selection operations

Replace core.PredicateComposition with new SelectionPredicateComposition class for selection parameter operations (~, &, |). This ensures consistent behavior and proper serialization of selection predicates. Test cases updated to reflect new parameter-based output format.

Add support for node groups in MPI distribute function

The distribute() function now accepts a group_nodes parameter to split MPI nodes into isolated groups. This allows nested distribute() calls by creating separate communicators for each group. The original communicator is restored after execution. Includes tests for the new functionality.

Add parallel execution support for YANK experiments

Introduce --jobid and --njobs CLI arguments to enable running subsets of experiments in parallel. The ExperimentBuilder now distributes experiments deterministically across jobs and ensures consistent ordering.

Lazy-load imports in CLI commands to improve startup time

Move module imports from top-level to function scope in command-line interface files. This reduces initial import overhead by only loading dependencies when they're actually needed by a specific command. The change affects analyze.py, script.py, selftest.py, and status.py command modules.

Optimize path hint logic by reusing Logic instance

The path hint calculation now reuses a single Logic instance across multiple checks instead of creating a new one each time. This improves performance by avoiding redundant initialization and state recalculation. The Logic class was extended with methods to save and restore its state for this purpose.

Handle session creation/destruction inside call_module

The call_module function now manages the GMT API session lifecycle internally, creating and destroying sessions automatically. This simplifies the API by removing the need to pass session objects around, matching the behavior of GMT's command-line interface. All calls to call_module have been updated accordingly.

Replace begin/end with global GMTSession instance

Remove the manual begin/end functions and replace them with a global GMTSession that automatically handles session management. The session starts when the module is imported and ends when Python exits. This simplifies the API and prevents common errors with session management.

Replace GMTSession class with direct begin/end calls

The GMTSession class was removed in favor of directly calling begin() and end() functions, with session cleanup handled by atexit. This simplifies the session management code while maintaining the same functionality. The global session is now started explicitly and registered for cleanup on Python shutdown.

Add parallel test to RPC test suite and PV test mode

The changes enable extensive parallel block validation testing scenarios and introduce a new `-pvtest` mode that slows down input validation for testing purposes. The parallel test now includes multiple block competition scenarios with different sizes and timing to verify chain selection behavior.

Key changes include:
- Added `parallel --extensive` to extended RPC tests
- Implemented `-pvtest` flag to slow down input validation
- Expanded parallel test with multiple block competition cases
- Added test scenarios for different block sizes and arrival timing

Track multiple getdata messages and improve block sync tests

- Add sync_getdata helper to wait for specific getdata requests
- Replace sync_with_ping with more reliable waitFor checks

Add minValue support to nonNegativeDerivative functions

Extend perSecond and nonNegativeDerivative functions to handle counter wrap-around with a minimum value threshold, similar to existing maxValue behavior. This allows proper calculation of derivatives when counters reset to a non-zero minimum value.

Consolidate auth headers and support X-Supervisor-Token

Standardize authentication headers across requests by replacing `_getHassioHeaders` and `_getHaHeaders` with `_getAuthHeaders`. Add support for `X-Supervisor-Token` header as an alternative authentication method.

Replace custom JSON comparison with jsoncomparison library

Simplify the code by removing manual JSON comparison and pretty printing logic, replacing it with the jsoncomparison library. The new implementation is more maintainable and provides better diff output. Also added a --verbose flag to control debug output.

Add option to skip hash verification in HTTP fetches

Modified `fetch_http()` to accept a `is_check_hash` parameter that controls whether hash verification is performed. Updated all callers that don't need hash verification to pass `False`. This improves performance for cases where hash verification isn't necessary.

Move checksum validation logic to get_hash()

The get_hash() function now handles all checksum validation, including hex decoding and length checking. Removed redundant binascii.unhexlify calls throughout the codebase and centralized the error handling.

Add warning for missing desktop Qt dependency

When installing mobile Qt versions (android/ios), warn if the required desktop Qt version is missing. The warning includes the command to install the missing dependency. Add --autodesktop flag to automatically install the required desktop version instead of showing a warning.

Add GCE routing simulation to multi-host tests

Enable testing with simulated GCE instance routing by:
- Adding a simulate_gce_routing parameter to DockerHost
- Configuring /32 addresses and specific routes when enabled
- Modifying IP pools to use IP-in-IP in this mode
- Extending test_multi_host to run with both routing modes

Add PR comment trigger for test runs

Support triggering test runs via PR comments containing '[test]'. Also improves whitelist checking and PR info handling. The changes ensure tests can be initiated by whitelisted users through comments on open PRs.

Improve PR testing with better status updates and error handling

Add proper PR status updates throughout the testing process and handle errors more gracefully. Extract PR title/body separately to avoid JSON parsing issues. Update documentation to reflect new requirements and behavior. The changes ensure tests provide better feedback and are more reliable.

Check available memory instead of total in tests

The memory checks in test files now verify available memory rather than total memory. This ensures tests are skipped when the system doesn't have enough free memory to run them safely, rather than just checking the total installed memory.

Add garbage collection wrappers to stream tests

The change introduces `run_gc` decorators that ensure garbage collection runs before and after test execution, except on CI environments (Travis/AppVeyor). This helps manage memory usage during tests while maintaining consistent behavior across environments. The decorators are applied to most test functions across multiple test files.

Fix API example formatting in schema documentation

Consistently format multi-line API examples by removing extra whitespace and line breaks. This improves readability and maintains a uniform style across all schema documentation examples.

```
Set OpenROAD placement defaults in PDK definitions

Move OpenROAD tool variable defaults (place_density, pad_global_place, etc.) from the tool setup to individual PDK definitions (asap7, freepdk45, skywater130). The tool now reads these values from the PDK configuration instead of maintaining its own defaults. This ensures PDK-specific settings are centralized in their respective definitions.
```

Move docstring trimming utility to utils module

The `trim()` function was duplicated across multiple files and is now consolidated in the utils module. This change improves maintainability while preserving all existing functionality. The function is used for cleaning up docstring indentation in documentation generation and schema processing.

Improve TCL manifest generation with proper escaping

Add helper function to safely escape Python values for TCL output, handling special characters, nested structures, and environment variables. Includes tests for complex strings, tuples, booleans, and envvars.

Improve TCL string escaping in manifest generation

Change string escaping strategy from using curly braces to double quotes, which better preserves special characters in TCL output. This handles backslashes, brackets, and dollar signs more reliably while maintaining environment variable substitution for file paths. The new approach avoids permanently escaping curly braces in strings and provides more consistent behavior with TCL's parsing rules.

Track error and warning counts from logfile regex matches

Update check_logfile() to return match counts and use them to set metrics when suffixes are 'errors' or 'warnings'. Improve docstrings to clarify behavior and fix parameter order. Rename 'error' suffix to 'errors' in examples for consistency.

Extract tool setup into helper method and improve error metrics

Move tool setup logic into new _setup_tool method to reduce code duplication. 
Modify error/warning metric handling to accumulate counts rather than overwrite. 
Automatically add logfile to report if regex patterns are defined for errors/warnings. 
Update documentation to reflect these changes.

Allow numpy arrays and auto-sort band/channel ranges

Accept numpy arrays as input for band and channel parameters in CASDA queries. 
Automatically sort band and channel ranges when provided in reverse order. 
Update documentation with a 3D cutout example.

Validate SVO FPS query parameters

Add validation for query parameters in SVO FPS service to reject invalid parameters with a descriptive error message. Remove redundant test for VOTable parsing error since parameter validation now happens before the request is made.

Simplify test response setup by removing unused parameters

The diff removes redundant `context=None` and `headers=None` parameters from test response setups where they weren't being used. This makes the test code cleaner while maintaining the same functionality. Changes are consistent across multiple test files.

Add column attributes fixture for Gaia test cases

The diff introduces a new fixture `column_attrs` that defines column attributes (name, description, dtype) for test data. This fixture is then used to simplify column validation in multiple test methods by replacing repetitive `__check_results_column` calls with a loop that checks attributes against the fixture. The change makes the tests more maintainable while keeping the same validation coverage.

Replace test setup with fixtures for Gaia TAP queries

The diff replaces repeated test setup code with reusable pytest fixtures for both synchronous and asynchronous Gaia TAP queries. This simplifies the test cases by removing duplicate connection and response handling code while maintaining the same test coverage. The fixtures mock the server responses consistently across all test methods.

Convert Gaia test class to standalone functions

The test suite was restructured from a class-based approach to individual test functions. This improves test isolation and makes the test file more maintainable. All existing test cases were preserved, including validation checks for query parameters, error handling, and data retrieval operations.

Replace connHandler.url_encode() with direct urlencode() calls

The change removes the redundant url_encode() wrapper methods from connection handlers and replaces all calls with direct usage of urllib.parse.urlencode(). This simplifies the code by eliminating unnecessary indirection while maintaining the same functionality. The urlencode() imports were also cleaned up to avoid duplication.

Replace file reading with Path.read_text() in tests

The change replaces manual file reading operations using utils.read_file_content() with Path.read_text() calls. This simplifies test code by using modern pathlib operations and removes the now-unused read_file_content() utility function. The change affects multiple test files but maintains the same functionality.

Support CUDA stream on memory pool

Now, memory pool will have an arena (bins) for each stream
to avoid concurrent streams touch the same memory block

Complete overhaul of filter testing.

These tests are much more flexible now for when additional filters are added.

Use "import numpy as np" in the array_api submodule

This avoids importing everything inside the individual functions, but still is
preferred over importing the functions used explicitly, as most of them clash
with the wrapper function names.

Use _implementation on all functions that have it in the array API submodule

That way they only work on actual ndarray inputs, not array-like, which is
more inline with the spec.

Use better type signatures in the array API module

This includes returning custom dataclasses for finfo and iinfo that only
contain the properties required by the array API specification.

Make the array API left and right shift do type promotion

The spec previously said it should return the type of the left argument, but
this was changed to do type promotion to be consistent with all the other
elementwise functions/operators.

Implement the array API result_type() manually

np.result_type() has too many behaviors that we want to avoid in the array API
namespace, like value-based casting and unwanted type promotions. Instead, we
implement the exact type promotion table from the spec.

Fix for orphaned items that may develop from a failed watcher event.

- Also added optional (but on by default) silencing of verbose and useless botocore logs.

Add options to post metrics to queue

This commit adds an option to SM to post metrics to cloudwatch.
Metric data will be posted whenever scan queue items are added or
removed.

Use named field for command_template when generating ninja command.

The command template become easier to read with named field.

Rewrite custom_target template string substitution

Factor it out into a function in mesonlib.py. This will allow us to
reuse it for generators and for configure_file(). The latter doesn't
implement this at all right now.

Also includes unit tests.

Use the same function for detection of C and C++ compilers

The mechanism is identical which means there's a high likelihood of
unintended divergence. In fact, a slight divergence was already there.

Use an enum instead of strings for method names.

If a non-string value is passed as a method, reject this explicitly
with a clear error message rather than trying to match with it and
failing.

Add 'Compiler.get_display_language'

Use this when we print language-related information to the console and
via the Ninja backend.

Add ConfigToolDependency class

This class is meant abstract away some of the tedium of writing a config
tool wrapper dependency, and allow these instances to share some basic
code that they all need.

Enable searching system crossfile locations on more platforms

There's no reason not to also look in these places on Cygwin or OSX.  Don't
do this on Windows, as these paths aren't meaningful there.

Move test_cross_file_system_paths from LinuxlikeTests to AllPlatformTests.

Use include_directories for D impdirs.

Change the code to store D properties as plain data. Only convert them
to compiler flags in the backend. This also means we can fully parse D
arguments without needing to know the compiler being used.

Use test setups from the active (sub)project by default.

Replace the logic where a test setup with no project specifier defaults to
the main project with one that takes the test setup from the same
(sub)project from where the to-be-executed test has been read from.

Create a helper for checking if a string has a path component

This is used in a number of places, and in some places it is incomplete.
Use a helper to ensure it's used properly.

Fix b_ndebug=if-release option

Provide get_{type}_options_for_target() methods that unite {type} and builtin options.

Add macOS linker versioning information

This patch exploits the information residing in ltversion to set the
-compatibility_version and -current_version flags that are passed to the
linker on macOS.

Add 'install_mode' to all installable targets

This makes it possible to customize permissions of all installable
targets, such as executable(), libraries, man pages, header files and
custom or generated targets.

This is useful, for instance, to install setuid/setgid binaries, which
was hard to accomplish without access to this attribute.

Move to coredata some methods handling options

Those methods only use coredata object, so better just move them as a
coredata method.

Rename clike_langs to clink_langs for clarity

D is not a 'c-like' language, but it can link to C libraries. The same
might be true of Rust in the future and Go when we add support for it.

This contains no functionality changes.

Improve logging when dependency is anonymous

Various pieces of logging assume the dependency has a name, and aren't
grammatical if the dependency is '', so say it is anonymous instead.

Add new method: mlog.deprecation()

Instead of constructing it manually, use a helper.

Refactor getting the host system of a cross compiler

Use mesonlib.for_windows or mesonlib.for_cygwin instead of
reimplementing them.

Add CrossBuildInfo.get_host_system to shorten the repeated the code in
the mesonlib.for_<platform> methods.

Make `-std=` fallback remapping more robust

* The current version matching logic is brittle
  with respect to Clang. LLVM and Apple Clang use
  slightly different but nowadays overlapping
  version ranges. Instead, we now just check whether
  the compiler supports the given `-std=` variant
  and try its respective fallback instead of
  testing version ranges.

Use enum instead of `int` for compiler variants

* Enums are strongly typed and make the whole
  `gcc_type`/`clang_type`/`icc_type` distinction
  redundant.
* Enums also allow extending via member functions,
  which makes the code more generalisable.

Use a single ArgumentParser for all subcommands

This has the adventage that "meson --help" shows a list of all commands,
making them discoverable. This also reduce the manual parsing of
arguments to the strict minimum needed for backward compatibility.

Use correct environment for REGEN in VS backend.

Try to guess which VS Command Prompt was used for the Meson call.
If one is chosen invoke it before calling Meson in REGEN command.

Move the list of LLVM version suffixes to a common place

Both scan-build and llvm-config need the same list of LLVM version
suffixes. It is better to keep the list at a common place instead of
having several copies in different files, which is likely to become
out-of-sync when the list is updated.

Move git helper out into mesonlib for reuse

Reuse the git helper for `meson wrap` and `meson subprojects` so we
don't need to maintain the same git-colors-on-windows workarounds in
multiple places.

Refactor TestResult object initialization

Just add or alter attributes of the TestResult object, rather than many,
many invocations of the constructor with very similar arguments.

Define helper methods for TestResult to add the results of a step and
set the failure reason.

Convert test protocol into an enum

This gives us better type safety, and will be important as we add more
test methods

Delete redirected wrap files in subprojects purge

We need to store the original filename as well as whether the wrap was
redirected in order to properly purge the redirected wrap.

Add support for saving embeddings at intermediate epochs

Returns a list of intermediate embeddings in UMAP.embedding_list

Adjust UHV goals to new wonders

- second French goal now requires the Louvre and the Metropolitain instead of the Statue of Liberty
- second Mughal goal now requires Shalimar Gardens instead of Harmandir Sahib
- second American goal now also requires Brooklyn Bridge and Golden Gate Bridge

Update S3 storage driver so it suppots "region" constructor argument.

This way user can use this constructor class argument instead of using a
different driver class per region.

Also update code to return more user friendly error message if moved
permanently error is returned by the API.

Update setup.py so it doesn't rely on any functions from libcloud
packages.

This way we avoid having setup.py depend on typing, requests and other
modules libcloud depends on.

Add new storage API methods for downloading part of an object (range
download) and implement it for the S3 and local storage drivers.

Implement Range downloads for the Azure Blobs driver and move common
method which can be re-used by S3 based and Azure drivers to the base
driver class.

Allow user to pass "timeout" argument to ScriptDeployment and
ScriptFileDeployment class.

With this argument, user can specify optional command run timeout for
those deployment steps.

Update AWS error response XML parsing code so we also handle situation
where response doesn't have a namespace.

It looks like that in some cases AWS returns error response without a
namespace which previous version of the code didn't handle correctly.

Add tests which verify that all OpenStack driver can be instantiated
with all the supported auth versions.

NOTE: Those tests will fail right now due to the regressions being
introduced recently which breaks auth for some versions.

Support aliasing of input files and querying from stdin.

Because an input file might be referenced by its alias now, we
removed various 'os.path.realpath' normalizations and use
'normalize_file_path' more selectively now.

Handle special translation needed for 'likelihood' and 'concat' functions

Also slightly refactored and cleaned up translation of function expressions.

Handle translation of new computed virtual graph patterns

- uses new virtual graph function machinery for translation
- ensures we don't try to create indexes on virtual tables

Support dont-optimize switch on all or individual match clauses

This will use a CROSS JOIN operator where appropriate which in SQLite
will disable the query optimizer for those joins and process the joins
in the order listed.

Change to use argument name "geom" consistently.

Previously we had a mix of "geom" and "ref_geom" in Gammapy.

Add auto-generated unique names

- add auto-generated unique names for model and dataset on init and copy
- force unicity on datasets and skymodels

Add processing options for SkyModel and SkyDiffuseCube 

Add options to apply or not psf and edisp to SkyModel and SkyDiffuseCube

Add shorter tags for models

Redefine most of models tags with a list including shorter aliases to be used with model.create(tag) and in YAML serialization. By default the tag returned in model.to_dict() is the 0th tag which is also the class name.

Add option to remove default output in models yaml file

Add option full_output (True by default) to model.to_yaml() and .to_dict(). Switching to False remove the entries for min, max, frozen and error if they are the same than the class defaults or nan.

Add PiecewiseBrokenPowerLawSpectralModel

Add PiecewiseBrokenPowerLawSpectralModel, a generalised broken power law  defined by a set of energy and intensity values (nodes) that are piecewise connected by power laws.

Add ignore_comments to documentation

  the two flags since 'ignore_data_comments' is used in parsing the data
  section and 'ignore_comments' is used in parsing header sections.

Add functionality to update listener/STT config

When a new configuration is discovered the producer and consumer is shutdown, the config is read and a new producer-consumer pair is launched.

Make handlers for single scheduled events one shot

- add_event() now accepts the parameter once, registring the event as a one shot event.
- remove_event for non-existing events is handled

Use function attributes for intent decorators
This prevents needing to use a shared list which misbehaves when multiple skills initialize at once

Make skill ids use skill folder

Support for audio seek

The audioservice can now jump forward and backward in the audio stream/file

The functionality is accessed via the audioservice class's seek_forward(),
seek_backward() and seek() methods

Replace hashed meta with skill_gid as identifier

Update old style metaclasses

class kwarg syntax

Make register_intent decorator register all intent types

This makes the register_intent decorator work for all types of intents,
both Adapt and Padatious.

Make execute_test less complex

Split the long function into several smaller ones just retaining the
main logic.

Move listen trigger to last chunk of sentence

If rendering a chunk of a sentence takes too long time, the audio queue
may run out and trigger the listening.

This moves the listening trigger to after the last chunk.

Simplify and clean up curate_cache

- create helper functions for getting file stats and removing files in
order of age
- create wrapper function for turning MB into bytes

Fix remove_fallback()

remove_fallback() was mainly created for use internally during shutdown
and required the wrapped callable to be able to remove a handler. This
makes it general, using a mapping to find the wrapper from a handler if
needed. The method now also returns the success/failure status

Add wait_for_message() method to messagebus client

- Add some basic unittests

ProcessStatus tracks the process status and allows callbacks on changes
and status queries over the messagebus.

StatusCallbackMap is used to setup the callbacks

Use pyglet.options['ffmpeg_libs_win'] to give the FFmpeg lib filenames.

Using 2 queues for video packets and audio packets. Whenever the
queues have space, more packets are read from the stream.

This work will allow to remove more easily the audio thread in
favor of a scheduled call to refill the audio player.

Remove thread in DirectSound

We use instead pyglet.clock.schedule_interval_soft to regularly
refill the DirectSound buffer with new audio data.

When there is no video but only audio in the Source and the audio driver is silent,

event after the duration.

with loom.

enabled explicit descriptor and legacy wallet testing in the test
runner.

Use context managers to handle profiling

This avoids needing to remember to disable the profiler by every return statement, and reads more cleanly than using a `try` / `finally`

Add ability to construct RegressionManager with test/hook list

Standard constructor that uses discovery has been moved to the
`from_discovery` class method.

Displays task name, status, and current coroutine.

Convert resolve() to str.translate().

and improves performance.

Create separate set of constants for operations

entity operations.

Move shared static functions to utils

This allows other modules like the Celery worker to use them.

Add MonitOperator

This uses Monit's XML API and groups closely-timed Monit reloads
together.

Allow DeploymentConfig to take a KazooClient

This makes it easier to reuse the KazooClient for other things.

Reduce unnecessary "exists" watches

This allows managers to stop watches if it's clear they are no
longer needed.

Implement the datastore_v4.AllocateIds API

This allows clients to ensure that a list of entity IDs are never
re-allocated.

Simplify datastore error handling

If an error code is defined, the response body does not need to be
specified. This prevents encoding issues in cases when a response
message has required fields.

Use the EntityLock in the groomer

The allows the groomer to make index modifications under a lock

Allow Python runtime to use an external API server

If given an external api port, the Python runtime will use it to
make App Identity calls.

Attach list of groups to transaction node

the transaction is resolved.

Allow group locks to persist when commits fail

This prevents other clients from writing to a group before a large
batch is fully applied.

Simplify rollback_transaction method

This moves the protobuffer-related work to the proper layer.

Handle UpdateIndexes calls

This adds index definitions to a project's ZooKeeper node if they
aren't there yet.

Improve speed of rebalance script

unreasonably slow as the amount of data in a BOP cluster increases.

to be skipped if the user is already sure the sanity checks will
pass.

Stop routing deleted versions

This ensures that deleted versions are absent from the HAProxy
configuration file when HAProxy is reloaded.

Move protobuffer handling to different level

Parsing the commit request and populating the response should
happen at the protobuffer interface level rather than in
DatastoreDistributed.

Add service account name field to backup form

This allows users to schedule a mapreduce-backed job with a
custom service account name for backing up to an arbitrary GCS
account.

Support the service_account_name parameter

This allows GetAccessTokenRequests to specify a custom service
account for generating an authentication token.

Allow custom service accounts for restore ops

This extends the datastore admin interface to allow custom
service accounts for restore operations.

Add support for property metadata queries

This allows clients to request a list of property names and types
for all kinds in a given namespace.

Add subdirectories for aggregates

To enable multiple aggregates in a clean way in the output directory will now contain a sub-directory for each group for which the aggregate function is called

Add RepoVersion class to make handling of many arguments easier

There are a number of arguments being passed around, nearly all of
which are duplicated between the old and new versions. Moving these
into a separate class should hopefully make it simpler to follow
what is being done.

Improve combine metadata script

1. More detailed help message
2. Helpful errors printed if assertions fail
3. Encoding of metadata origin now uses explicit "yes"/"no" values
rather than using the empty string.

Refactor sanitizer transform logic

Move logic to parse mapping of old to new column names and strip
prefixes into their own functions with tests. This refactoring
simplifies the code in the main body of the sanitizer script.

Support selecting objects under the current folder

Add a special single dot notation for filtering stories, plans and
tests under the current working directory. Update documentation
and usage messages accordingly.

Support short Fedora compose aliases in testcloud

Adds support for 'fedora' as the latest released Fedora, 'rawhide'
for the latest Rawhide plus 'fedora-X', 'f-X' and 'fX' shortcuts.

Move the Guest class from base to steps.provision

Here it makes more sense as it is related to provision classes.

Adjust the minute provision debug messages wording

Just a couple of minor cosmetic adjustments to make the messages
consistent with the rest.

Adjust the default branch handling for libraries

Detect the default branch and store it after cloning the repo.
This seems to make the implementation a bit more readable.

Implement a generic `requires` for all plugins

Add support for gathering packages required on the guest to all
supported plugins to allow easier future extension if needed.

Add a nice provisioning progress to Artemis plugin

Artemis plugin now displays the sequence of of guest states
as its provisioning progresses. This has been implemented as
a reusable primitive context manager, coupled with a small
refactoring of code taking care of indentation.

Enhance tmt.utils.retry_session with timeout support

`retry_session` is now usable as a context manager, and accepts a
timeout to honor for each HTTP request.

Current `retry_session` was overlapping with similar functionality in
`artemis` plugin, so merged both together and threw context manager in
too, because `retry_session` was used in that manner exclusively.

Convert guest implementations to use serializable container for load/save

Instead of custom load/save methods, use those based on dataclasses. We
gain type annotations, automagic conversion from/to YAML, no need for
explicit moves of fields between instances and serialized data.

btime in /proc/stat is boot time in seconds since epoch and reboot()
will make sure that it has changed

Remove unused keys parameter from wake() methods

This seems to be no longer used, and makes `wake()` more complicated
than necessary.

Unify Polarion case searching

Save and load ids to/from results.yaml.
Add constant for extra identification keys.
Raise ReportError on TC not found in Polarion.

Replace blank "type: ignore" with more specific waivers

Using mypy's error codes, waivers can target the actual erorr, leaving
space for other kind of violations to not be suppressed.

Add a helper for importing a member from a module

This primitive appeared twice already, and follows the same
scenario: import a module, then locate a member (a class, usually)
in the module, and catch possible errors along the way.

Document & correct use of class conversion methods

Recently added `{to,from}_{serialized,raw,dict}` methods for various
conversions were poorly documented, and sometimes even wrongly used.
This patch adds a short summary on when to use them, and fixes some
sub par bits around the code.

Drop various guest `wake()` methods in favor of parent class

They all do the same things anyway: instantiate a guest class, with
given data, pass parent and name down the stream. A base class can do
all of this.

Fix resuming of SOBOL generator during ax search

This is done by fixing the seed and regenerating trials already performed.

Support for dataset-specific configurations and metadata

preprocess now creates a dataset.yaml file with information about
the dataset.

Add support for relation prediction

Added a score_so method to KgeModel for this purpose and a default
implementation in RelationalScorer (which is currently used by all models).

This makes them valid identifiers, which allows to use query types as
configuration keys (for example).

Add MPI parallelization on different MPI communicators.

Add jobid and njobs argument to script command.

This allows to run multiple experiments from the same script in several parallel executions of YANK.

Move CLI imports into functions for speed

In order to prevent the CLI from taking long times due to importing everything, especially when the user mis-types a command for docopt to handle, import statements for the CLI functions have been moved to the actual functions instead of the module header

Avoid instantiating tons of different logic instances and just reuse the same instance by resetting its state every time it's needed.

Create and destroy C sessions inside call_module

command line app does anyway so it's not wasteful.

Replace the global GMTSession with 'atexit'

No need for the class or the global instance. Register 'end' with
'atexit' to make sure end is called when exiting Python.

Also add the needed option -pvtest which slows down the checking
of inputs by putting a sleep time of 1 second for each input to
check.  This allows up to simulate very long to validate blocks
used in the attack scenarios.

Numerous timing issues do with the the multi-threading and also
the requestmanager. Better to no rely on sync_with_ping() and also
we have to handle getheaders requests and subsequent multi hash
getdata requests.

It works in a way similar to maxValue: when the counter wraps, instead of
producing a null value, it computes the difference assuming the counter wrapped
to minValue.

Use library instead of ad-hoc code

`compare_combos` with `jsoncomparison.Compare`.

turned on and the expected desktop Qt is not found.

Add test to simulate GCE instance setup

This change adds a test that sets up hosts' addressing and routing as it
is on a GCE instance, and checks that we still get connectivity between
workloads on different hosts.

Allow tests to be run on demand

With this change, a string "[test]" can be added as a comment to a pull
request by a whitelisted user to initiate testing on a pull request

Refactor to update pull requests with pending status

This commit refactors code to update the pull request with a pending
status at the earliest possible time.

Additionally, this refactor includes fixes an issue where unexpected
characters in the pull request title or body caused issues parsing
github webhook payload json

Check for available memory instead of its total amount in tests

This change prevents the python interpreter from triggering the
OOM-killer while trying to use/allocate more memory than available on
the system.

Reduce pressure on memory in stream tests

This change runs the python garbage collector before and after each
stream test.

The garbage collector is disabled in the CI since it has a significant
impact on the duration of the jobs (which are time constrained in the CI).

Fix multiline strings in schema examples

Using '\' or multiline strings results in extra whitespace, so it seems
best to use Python's automatic concatenation of adjacent strings.

Remove PDK-specific var defaults from openroad.py

We shouldn't be hardcoding tech-specific values in tool setup scripts,
so we should use the new ['pdk', 'variable'] parameter to drive these.

In order to support user overrides, we'll still drive them through the
['eda', ... 'variable'] keypath in the TCL script.

Fix RST parsing in schemagen

- Use Python standardized docstring "trim" function to preserve newlines
  and indentation in schelp strings.
- Fix schemagen parse_rst() to handle multiline text

Make _print_tcl() more robust

- Use {} to escape strings, so that we can have spaces and newlines
- Dump tuples as lists to avoid parsing
- Make sure envvar syntax gets subbed in anywhere in string

Tweak string escape approach

Use "" instead of {} to remove persistent backslashes in front of curly
braces in string.

Make tool regex set errors/warnings metrics

- "errors" and "warnings" suffix is special case
- Also update docs for relevant schema param and check_logfile()

Make regex errors/warnings additive, add reports

- Enables tools to extract additional errors/warnings from other logs
- Add logfiles under reports to reduce boilerplate, the logfiles always
  belong if regex is used

Add a spectral cutout example

Also include support for numpy arrays for band and channel, and autocorrect the band and channel values to be in ascending order

Validate `svo_fps` query parameter names locally

`SvoFpsClass.data_from_svo()` now checks the names of the query
parameters and only connects with the server if all names are valid.

Simplify setting DummyResponse data in TAP+ tests

`DummyResponse` is used in `esa/jwst` and `gaia` tests for mimicking
server responses. Now the response data can be specified by only setting
the parameters that have non-default values.

Simplify column attribute checking in `gaia` tests

The function `__check_results_column()` tested if the attributes (e.g.
description) of the columns of the query results match the expectation.
This function is now replaced with
`astropy.table.BaseColumn.attrs_equal()`, and the comparison data is now
provided by a `pytest` fixture.

Reduce duplication in setting up `gaia` tests

The new module level fixtures allowed removing setup code from many
tests.

Remove `TestTap` class from `gaia` tests

Grouping the tests together in a test class served no purpose and
eliminating the class removed a level of indentation.

Remove `utils.tap.conn.TapConn.url_encode()`

The removed method simply called the standard library
`urllib.parse.urlencode()`.

Remove an utility function for reading test data

`astroquery.utils.tap.xmlparser.utils.read_file_content()` has been
replaced with the standard library `pathlib.Path.read_text()`.
Furthermore, in the modules where multiple test functions previously
used `read_file_content()` to read the data files, they are now read
once at the module level instead.
